text:
alex: heads-up — SLO burn alert for api.ingress.p95 and a correlated spike in 5xx from the hosted inference gateway. Started ~12:05 UTC. seeing higher client timeout errors and a few customer escalations.

ops-bot: ALERT: SLO api.ingress.p95 >= 2s for 15m (burning). alert_id=ingress-p95-19385, severity=critical :rotating_light:

maria: digging into dashboards now — loading `ingress/gateway-overview` -> seeing 5xx rate jump from 0.4% to 6% in eu-west cluster around 12:03. latency median up too.

jin: any recent deploys or canary rollouts?

alex: canary of model-router v2.3 rolled at 11:58 UTC to 10% traffic. I routed canary by region+model. Might be related.

lisa: quick check — traces show many requests timing out in proxy before hitting backend in the failing traces. stack: edge-proxy -> authz -> model-router -> model-worker. trace gap between authz and model-router in ~40% of failed traces.

maria: running a log query: `sum by(status) (rate(ingress_requests_total{region="eu-west"}[5m]))` shows 5xx mostly 502/504.

alex: can you paste the Prom query for timeout detection?

maria: sure — PromQL I used: `sum(rate(ingress_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="2.0"}[5m])) / sum(rate(ingress_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]))` and `sum(rate(ingress_requests_total{status=~"5..",region="eu-west"}[5m]))`

jin: also see increased TCP RSTs on edge-proxy logs: `tcp_conn_reset{node=~"edge-.*"}` spiking. Could be connection pooling exhaustion to model-router.

support-bot: ticket #INC-4821 created by support at 12:10 UTC — customer reported timeout errors and retries. referencing request ids: r-9a3f, r-9b7c.

lisa: quick repro (from prod replicate): curl to ingress with header `X-Model: canary-v2.3` sometimes returns 504 after ~30s — when backend model-worker is slower under quantization path. Also observed increased backend queue length on model-router metrics: `model_router_queue_depth` up to 80.

alex: action plan: 1) scale model-router pool for eu-west and increase connection pool size to workers, 2) roll back canary to 0% if scaling doesn't restore SLO, 3) add temporary routing rule to fallback to stable model variant, 4) surface findings to product + support.

maria: I kicked autoscaler to +2 pods (manual) for model-router-eu-west and bumped max connections. Watching metrics now.

ops-bot: deploybot: scaled statefulset/model-router-eu-west replicas 3 -> 5 by maria at 12:17 UTC.

jin: can we instrument whether the authz latency contributes? I see authz latency 95p also up ~300ms but not enough to explain 2s p95.

lisa: tracing sample after scaling: requests that previously failed now often succeed but we still have ~1% 5xx. trace gaps reduced — KV cache hits increased after model-router scaling.

maria: added a temporary Grafana panel showing `model_router_queue_depth`, `worker_latency_p95`, `edge_tcp_rst_rate`, and `canary_traffic_pct`. Sharing link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress/ingress-overview?orgId=1

alex: support — can you notify affected customers that we're actively mitigating and rolling back canary if necessary? mention possible increased latency during mitigation.

support-bot: message posted to #support-incidents: "Investigating higher timeout rates for hosted inference in eu-west; mitigation in progress."

maria: if canary rollback needed, we should confirm version matrix: stable model-router v2.2 + stable model-worker v1.9 have no regressions. Also create a short postmortem checklist.

jin: temporary mitigation worked at 12:24 — p95 dropped below 2s and 5xx rate to 0.9%. Keeping scaling in place for now.

alex: leaving canary paused at 0% and will schedule a canary test with reduced concurrency + tracing enabled.

lisa: notes for follow-up: - observe connection pool sizing defaults, - add circuit-breaker config to model-router for slow workers, - add alert that correlates canary traffic pct with 5xx rate (to avoid silent rollouts).

maria: filing incident ticket INC-4821 -> SRE-19385 with summary and queries, attaching traces and repro steps.

alex: thanks team. final checklist: keep autoscaled replicas until 13:00 UTC, collect 30m of golden traces, prepare rollback blameless postmortem.

support-bot: update: customer A (cust-42) acknowledged mitigation at 12:40 UTC.

jin: follow-up action items assigned: maria (dashboards + alert refinement), lisa (circuit-breaker PR), alex (canary test + postmortem).

alex: marking thread resolved for now — will reopen if SLO regresses. :white_check_mark:
